title: World Footballer TCG: Ready for Epic Brazil vs. Japan
author: Demirobo
selftext: I have developed a new configuration for World Footballer- TCG, leveraging Generative AI to power both the underlying football simulation and the entire frontend design in celebration of the 2026 World Cup. The platform allows users to assemble lineups featuring teams like the Seleção and the Samurai Blue, with the added functionality to personalize the national squads and icons by uploading custom photos. Once a squad is built, users can challenge others globally. The project can be found at[https://wfbtcg.poppingcraft.com](https://wfbtcg.poppingcraft.com)  . Github will be disclosed in the coming future.
